headerSubtitle: Creating opportunities through technology, digital learning, and collaboration.
sec1_intro: The Client shall provide the following information:
sec2_p1: This Agreement establishes the understanding between CloudSwyft Global Systems Inc. and [ORGANIZATION], represented by [REPRESENTATIVE], regarding their proposed [TYPE].
sec2_p2: The partnership/collaboration shall focus on [FOCUS], with the Parties working together toward the objectives and expected outcomes mutually agreed upon under this Agreement.
sec2_p3: The specific activities, responsibilities, resources, and other arrangements shall be determined based on the nature and scope of the partnership/collaboration.
sec3_intro: The Client shall provide the following information regarding the proposed partnership or collaboration:
sec4_partner_items: Provide accurate and complete information relevant to the partnership or collaboration.
Participate in the agreed activities and initiatives.
Provide the necessary information, materials, or resources that have been mutually agreed upon.
Communicate relevant updates, concerns, or changes to CloudSwyft.
Comply with the mutually agreed terms for the partnership or collaboration.
sec4_cloud_items: Coordinate with the Partner regarding the agreed partnership or collaboration.
Participate in the mutually agreed activities and initiatives.
Provide relevant information and resources that have been agreed upon by both parties.
Communicate relevant updates and requirements to the Partner.
Work with the Partner toward the agreed objectives of the collaboration.
sec5_p1: The Partner and CloudSwyft shall maintain the confidentiality of non-public information shared in connection with the partnership or collaboration.
sec5_p2: Neither party shall disclose confidential information to unauthorized individuals or organizations unless otherwise agreed upon or required by applicable law.
sec6_p1: The Partner and CloudSwyft shall agree in writing to any significant changes to the purpose, scope, responsibilities, or other terms of this Agreement.
sec6_p2: Additional activities or initiatives may be included upon mutual agreement.
sec6_p3: The Parties shall communicate with each other regarding any proposed changes to the partnership or collaboration.
sec6_p4: Any changes to the purpose, scope, activities, responsibilities, timeline, or other significant terms of this Agreement shall be discussed and mutually agreed upon by the Parties.
sec6_p5: The Partner shall not be required to undertake additional activities or responsibilities that were not included in the original agreement unless such changes have been mutually agreed upon.
sec6_p6: Where necessary, the Parties shall document the agreed changes through a written amendment, updated agreement, or other form of documented approval.
sec6_p7: Any approved changes shall form part of the Agreement and shall be followed by both Parties.
sec7_p1: This Agreement may be terminated before the expected end date by either Party upon written notice to the other Party.
sec7_p2: Upon termination, the Parties shall communicate regarding any ongoing activities, responsibilities, or commitments that need to be completed or addressed.
sec7_p3: Any provisions of this Agreement that are intended to remain in effect after termination, including confidentiality and intellectual property obligations, shall continue to apply.
sec8_p1: The Partner shall confirm that all information provided in this Agreement is accurate and complete.
sec8_p2: By completing the required information and providing an electronic signature, the Partner acknowledges that the Partner has read, understood, and agreed to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
sec8_p3: The Partner further acknowledges that the proposed partnership, collaboration, project, or initiative has been discussed and mutually understood by both Parties. The Partner agrees to fulfill the responsibilities and commitments mutually agreed upon with CloudSwyft, and understands that any additional activities, commitments, or changes shall be subject to mutual agreement between the Parties.
sec8_p4: By providing an electronic signature, the authorized representatives acknowledge their agreement to the terms stated in this Agreement.
sec9_title: 9. USE AND REPRODUCTION OF CLOUDSWYFT MATERIALS
sec9_p1: The Client shall not reproduce, copy, modify, distribute, publish, or otherwise use the CloudSwyft name, logo, branding, documents, materials, or other proprietary content provided in connection with this Agreement without the prior written consent of CloudSwyft Global Systems Inc.
sec9_p2: The CloudSwyft name, logo, and other materials included in this Agreement are provided solely for the purpose of reviewing and completing the proposed partnership or collaboration.
sec9_p3: Any permitted use following the execution of this Agreement shall remain subject to the terms and conditions agreed upon by the Parties.
completion_text: Once the required information has been completed and the authorized representatives have provided their electronic signatures, the completed Agreement shall be retained by the Parties for reference.
footer_text: Thank you for partnering with CloudSwyft.
